name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: Security, reliability and bandwidth release. Android raw-file playback no longer enters its HLS-only direct-play path, preventing source errors while preserving original-quality streaming. Direct links become usable as soon as they authenticate while their speed test finishes; a slow or failed test keeps the existing Auto WAN cap instead of removing it. Link setup and forwarding are bounded, permissions and capacity are rechecked before a friend connects, and unexpected sources are refused before TLS. Playback recovers interrupted relays, retains slow converted segments, falls back after direct-link body failures, avoids duplicate bandwidth samples, and uses per-stream bitrates when ranking copies. Catalogs can use Brotli; posters are fetched at sharp display sizes rather than as originals. Also includes reviewed admin, credential, SSRF, response, transcode-admission and Companion-update hardening. Pairing codes remain disabled while under review. Includes everything in 0.0.199.
